files.reason: Lane w11a-codex-adapter (arm O; D8 sections 1 and 3, D8:461-472; ruling Q-3): CodexAdapter, agent_adapter's interface for codex: one `codex exec --json` per turn through box/run_take.run_turn, `-m <model>` on every exec, `resume <thread id>` after the first turn only (the id read from turn 1's thread.started), the routing pin's mode looked up in MODE_FLAGS (D8:110), the version from `codex --version`; read_stream maps the documented events and items into the seam's records (api_errors from error and turn.failed only, never the agent's text; usage from turn.completed, a missing key refused, never 0; agent_output from event and item types); read_rollout takes the init's model from the rollout's turn_context, never the requested model. SHAPES_SOURCE = documented, reported in the harness record and every turn record. Not registered in any seam table (a later seam slice). Review round 1 fold: a line that is not JSON is accepted only as the stream's last line; the error words are read from the typed record; the mode check is one table lookup; the version exec's stdout must be a string. Live harness slice 6 (edit without transfer, under glitch-06's order, 14 Oct 2026): the exec is kept in executed_turns before any read; the stream read, resumed-thread check and rollout read moved verbatim into _read_turn; a refusal after the exec is ExecutedStreamRefused (a StreamError and an agent_adapter.ExecutedTurnRefused). No identity-source table. Bound by tests/test_codex_executed_refusal.py. Review nit 3: any other exception after the exec becomes a plain ExecutedTurnRefused (a defect, never a StreamError); BaseException still propagates.

Lane w11a-codex-adapter: the pre-registered Codex exec stream tables (D8 section 1's event types, item types and usage keys, and the keys it names as not in D8), check_record (anything off the tables refused, never guessed) and CodexParser into transcript_view.RawItem's closed vocabulary (command_execution -> shell, file_change -> write or edit, mcp_tool_call -> other, agent_message -> agent-text, reasoning -> agent-reasoning). NOT registered in transcript_view.PARSERS. Review round 1 fold: every documented value is type-checked (a bool is never an int), a file_change's changes are checked in check_record, an event or item type that is not a string is a typed refusal, and two unused names are gone.

Lane w11a-codex-adapter (arm O, next-slices-plan-2026-10-12 section 2): the Codex CLI adapter and its stream parser on synthetic streams over a fake runtime: S1-S3 the closed event, item and key tables, P1 the view vocabulary through transcript_view.events with the parser in a copy of PARSERS for the test only, A1-A7 the stream read, the harness's errors kept apart from the agent's text, usage refused when a key is missing, the argv (-m every exec, resume after turn 1 only), the model from the rollout, the end reasons, SHAPES_SOURCE documented; whole-file witnesses of codex_adapter.py and transcript_codex.py compiled in memory. Review round 1 fold (ruling w11a-R1-fold): B1-B11 bind each condition and clause one case at a time (end_reason, the thread id at three seats, required keys, value types, the rollout init, usage values, empty model or line, blank messages, the cut last line, the turn record, the version exec), A7 requires a RECORDED label's walk id and harness version, and --generated-mutants (shardable) runs a generated mutation sweep of both modules with an EQUIVALENT list whose stale entries fail. Live-harness foundation: P1 now requires a bound published parser instead of asserting the future seam has not registered; native parser mapping assertions remain unchanged. Live harness (glitch-06's Codex ruling, option a, 14 Oct 2026): every turn here and in test_codex_executed_refusal runs through stub_run_turn, a plain agent exec that never reads a login and carries no credential (patched in setUpModule; a test checks it is in place and never opens the login file); A4's clause 'the login rides by name only' is retired with a dated note (it described the API-key route the reviewed subscription transition removed); the login value never riding in an argv stays checked. Nothing enables an API-key route; run_take's NotReady refusal of a Codex turn before any login read is bound outside this module (integration lane daf4311b, test_env_allowlist).
